description: Public ACME options with a secret presence marker; legacy account values remain visible for repair

email.description: Account contact email; empty when no contact email is configured

account_id.description: Selected Certbot account identifier; empty uses automatic account selection

agree_tos.description: Whether the configured ACME subscriber agreement is accepted

must_staple.description: Whether new ACME certificates request the OCSP Must-Staple extension

ocsp_stapling.description: Whether ACME certificates use OCSP stapling

server_tls_verify.description: Whether the ACME server TLS certificate is verified

custom_ocsp_stapling.description: Whether uploaded certificates use OCSP stapling

default_certificate_id.description: Certificate used for application and default-site TLS; zero selects the generated dummy certificate

eab_hmac_key_set.description: Whether an encrypted External Account Binding HMAC key is saved
